The epitope of TAU-2212 on the SARS-CoV-2 S was determined from the cryo EM reconstruction of SARS-CoV-2 spike in complex with mAb TAU-2212 in conformation 4 at a resolution of 3.30 Å. Fab2212 is not able to form a stable complex with the prefusion stabilized SARS-CoV-2 spike ecto-domain, but interacts with spike trimer on the cell surface. Therefore, TAU-2212-protein A coated beads were used to pull down spike trimers, which were then subjected to cryoEM structural analysis. CryoEM 3-dimensional (3D) classiﬁcation of the particles revealed that TAU-2212 binds the spike trimer in ﬁve distinct conformations. In all ﬁve conformations, only the Fab portion of mAb TAU-2212 is visible. Conformations 1, 3 and 4 are composed of two, three and three bound Fabs, respectively, with all the RBDs in the “down” position. Conformation 2 has one Fab per trimer, with one RBD in the “up” conﬁguration, and conformation 5 has two head-to-head spike proteins, which are crosslinked by three mAbs. This structure described is conformation 4.
